items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Glyn Paque on alto sax... and you're on drums.

ctx.x: "Struggle Buggy" was done in 1930. "Struggle Buggy" was May 22nd, 1930, with King Oliver and Dave Nelson. Well, Dave Nelson was still with the band. In fact, the band was Jimmy Archey, trombone; Bobby Holmes on clarinet and alto saxophone; Glyn Paque on alto sax; apparently Charles Frazier was on tenor; and there was Don Frye, and there was also Eric Franker on piano; the banjo player was either Arthur Taylor on most selections, it seems, or Walter Jones; and Clinton Walker was the tuba player, and you're on…
Did they have "Boogie Woogie" and "Mule Face," all them numbers?
